mapper.select: select column_name as columnName, (case when (is_nullable = 'no' && column_key != 'PRI') then '1' else '0' end) as isRequired, (case when column_key = 'PRI' then '1' else '0' end) as isPk, ordinal_position as sort, column_comment as columnComment, (case when extra = 'auto_increment' then '1' else '0' end) as isIncrement, column_type as columnType from information_schema.columns where table_schema = (select database()) and table_name = (#{tableName}) order by ordinal_position
